supporting_observations.claim: The account svc-claimsync experienced repeated failed logon attempts starting at 13:31 UTC, shortly after the scheduled password rotation at 13:30 UTC.
All failed authentication attempts for svc-claimsync originated from FILE-HD-01 (IP 10.30.20.20), which is the host where the ClaimSync job is configured to run.
The failures are consistent with a service account attempting to run with an outdated password following the scheduled rotation at 13:30 UTC.

unrelated_findings: Record T002-00019 shows a process 'C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe' on WS-LPARK-01 attempting to access PROXY-HD-01 using svc-claimsync credentials, which does not align with the approved software list (CobaltVault is listed, but not Commvault) or the described purpose of svc-claimsync.
